Around the clock ignores the time of day.
By species behaviour applies the multiplier below during each species' active hours:
rabbit and raccoon 19:00-05:00 (the game's own trapping data), deer at dawn and dusk,
mouse and rat are active all day and get no bonus.
Never Spawn In Sight
Skip spots a player can currently see. Single player only: the engine check needs a local player index and does nothing on a dedicated server.
Young With Females
Chance that a female placed by the mod brings a young one along.\\nVanilla herds run 20 for deer and 40 for rabbit. 0 places adults only.
Extra Migration Routes Menu

Adds a Forest migration routes entry to the right-click menu in the world, where extra deer and rabbit routes can be previewed and then written into this save. Nothing is built until you pick Apply the plan to the save and confirm it. How to use: right-click the ground, Build a plan on the map, open the world map (M) and look at the yellow and red loops, change Extra Routes Multiplier and plan again if the density is wrong, then Apply the plan to the save, and reload the save straight afterwards without travelling anywhere. Applying cannot be undone - the routes become part of the save file, so back up the save folder first. Routes can only be placed where the game own map files describe the forest, so forest that stays empty after planning cannot take them at all - a limit of the game files, not of the mod. How many routes appear also depends on the game own Animal Paths Chance option.
Debug Logging
Print every scan, spawn and rejection reason to the console and add the FWD Debug right-click menu. Also on automatically when the game runs with -debug.
Deer Chance Per Day
Chance per day of a deer group being placed in suitable forest.
Deer Male Ratio
Share of males in a placed group. 0.5 is an even split; lower means more females, higher more males.\n0.0 means no males and the group will never breed. Vanilla herds run about 0.25.
Enable Wildlife Scan
Master switch for the hourly scan that places wild animals around you. Off leaves only the route options below.
Feral Farm Animals

Livestock and poultry that wandered off the farms, placed loose in and around the woods. Useful on a long save where the game has already cleared the farms and there is nothing left to breed from. They keep their vanilla behaviour: none of them flee from you, and chickens and turkeys cannot graze off the ground, because making them act feral would mean editing shared animal definitions and changing every coop bird on the map. They are not flagged as wild, so you can catch them, lead them home and pen them.
Young With Farm Females
Chance that a placed farm female brings a young one along.\\n0 places adults only. A young animal needs its mother alive nearby.
Farm Save Wide Cap
Total farm animals from this mod across the whole save.\\nSeparate from the wildlife cap, because these are not flagged wild and the wildlife counter cannot see them.
Chicken Chance Per Day
Chance per day of a loose chicken being placed.\\nThey do not flee and cannot feed off the ground - vanilla farm bird behaviour, kept as is.
Cow Chance Per Day
Chance per day of a loose cow being placed.\\nLowest by default, because one cow is an enormous amount of meat. A bull fights back when stressed.
Farm Group Size
How many animals a single farm spawn places.\\n1 keeps them solitary strays, which also means they never breed on their own.
Horse Chance Per Day

Chance per day of a loose horse being placed. Needs the Horse Mod; without it this setting does nothing.\\nA horse can be tamed, saddled and ridden. A stressed stallion fights back and can knock you down.
Farm Male Ratio
Share of males among placed farm animals. 0.5 is an even split, lower means more females.\\nShared by all farm species.
Multiplier Near Farms
Chance multiplier on farmland, pasture, ranch land and the woods bordering them.\\nThis and the next multiplier replace the per-forest sliders above for farm animals.
Pig Chance Per Day
Chance per day of a loose pig being placed.\\nPigs graze off the ground, so they can genuinely live out there.
Sheep Chance Per Day
Chance per day of a loose sheep being placed.\\nSheep graze off the ground. A ram fights back when stressed.
Turkey Chance Per Day
Chance per day of a loose turkey being placed.\\nBuild 42 has no wild turkey, only the farm bird, so this is the way to meet one in the woods.
Multiplier In Other Forest
Chance multiplier everywhere else in the forest, away from farmland.\\n0 keeps feral farm animals strictly around farms.
Save Wide Cap
Total animals from groups this mod has placed across the whole save.\nThe count corrects itself whenever you pass a group again.
Group Size
Multiplier on how many animals a placed group contains.
Extra Routes Multiplier

Route density relative to vanilla: the game's roll count per cell times this, at the chance set by the vanilla option Animal Paths Chance.
1.0 is vanilla density, 1.2 adds about a fifth.
